card.name: Last piece of a brand name
card.fires_on: The final piece of a brand or trade name, just before where a registered or trademark symbol (® or ™) would go. It appears in drug and product names such as Viagra, Demerol, Betadine and Pegasys.

modes.label: Drug brand names
modes.description: Ending of a brand drug name, often written in capitals or in parentheses after the generic name.

modes.label: Product names with symbol
modes.description: Ending of a device or test product name, followed by ® or ™.

card.writes: It promotes trademark symbols such as ®, ™ and TM right after the brand name.
card.plain: It marks the end of a brand name, where a trademark symbol usually comes next.
